description: Synchronize watch states between connected users for linked TV shows
name: Watch State Sync
overview: Links TV shows between groups of two or more users. When any user in a group watches or marks an episode as (un)watched, all other users in the group are updated automatically. Manage connections from the Watch State Sync page in the admin dashboard.

versions.changelog:
Fix: series list 500 error and empty user dropdown

- GetSeries endpoint now filters at the database level with
  IncludeItemTypes=Series (using the correct Jellyfin.Data.Enums
  namespace), avoiding deserialization errors on items from
  uninstalled plugins
- Users and series load independently so one failure doesn't block both
- Minor: icon spacing fix on the Add User button

Fix: Add Connection button does nothing

Modals and script were outside the data-role='page' div. Jellyfin only
injects that div's content into the live document, so modal elements
were never accessible and button clicks threw silent TypeErrors.

Fix plugin showing as version 0.0.0.0 after installation

GenerateAssemblyInfo=false was suppressing the generated assembly
version attributes, so the version baked into the DLL was always
0.0.0.0 regardless of the release tag. This also caused the plugin
icon to disappear after installation since Jellyfin couldn't match
the installed plugin to a catalog entry.

Fix admin page event handling and apply Jellyfin-native styling

- Buttons on the admin page now work correctly (event handlers were
  not being registered due to a page lifecycle timing issue)
- Form errors are now visible instead of being silently swallowed
- Styling updated to use Jellyfin native CSS classes

Fix admin page rendering in Jellyfin 10.11.x

The configuration page was blank after clicking the menu item.
Root cause: Jellyfin's dashboard page system requires a wrapper div
with data-role='page' to locate and mount plugin content.
Initialization is also moved to the pageshow event so ApiClient is
available when the callback fires.

## What's new

**Variable-size sync groups** — connections now support any number of users (2+), not just pairs.

- When creating or editing a connection, use the **+ Add user** button to include a third, fourth, or more users.
- When any user in the group watches or marks an episode, all other users in the group are updated automatically.
- The initial OR-merge on connection creation now runs across all N users in the group.

## Breaking change

The internal configuration format changed between 0.1 and 0.2.  Any connections configured in 0.1 will need to be re-entered after upgrading.

Initial release of Watch State Sync.

Synchronises watch states between connected user pairs for linked TV shows.
When a connection is first created, existing watch states are merged with
a logical OR: if either user has already watched an episode, it is marked
as watched for both.
